name: Vimeo.com, Inc.
blurb: Vimeo.com, Inc. provides video software solutions, including hosting, editing, live-streaming, and AI-powered tools for businesses and creative professionals. The company serves a range of customers from small businesses to large enterprises, with a focus on high-quality, ad-free video experiences. As of November 2025, Vimeo was acquired by Bending Spoons US and delisted from NASDAQ.
recent: On November 24, 2025, Vimeo was delisted from NASDAQ after being acquired by Bending Spoons US for $1.38 billion in cash, with shareholders receiving $7.85 per share. The acquisition closed in late November 2025, ending Vimeo's public trading history.
